verdict.rationale: PostHog documents US/EU region selection at signup (--region us flag) and confirms the MCP/auth layer routes to the correct data region (US or EU) based on account, with self-hosting also offered as a full data-residency option. However, evidence only names two regions (US/EU) with no broader residency/localization options, no details on data transfer/compliance certifications, and no independent confirmation of enforcement. missing for 10: broader region choices beyond US/EU, compliance/certification documentation (e.g. GDPR/SOC2 region guarantees), and independent/hands-on verification of residency enforcement.
